reviews.text: Excellent service

I went for the first time because of an emergency, at a time when my trusted vet was on vacation.
Iñaki will surely become my new go-to vet. Thank you for letting me come despite the inconvenient hours. We'll keep seeing each other with all the pigeons that decide to cross my path when they're feeling unwell.
In the pictures is Tomate, a pigeon we found very weak one day during heavy rain, and who, thanks to Iñaki, is now perfectly healthy!
Thank you from the bottom of my heart.
A great professional, thanks for everything.
A true professional, with a friendly and personal touch. They've helped us with our pet and its care, whether it's an emergency or not. Thank you.
Fantastic and highly recommended
Everything was perfect except for punctuality.

Incredible! I'm thrilled with the service! It's clear they specialize in exotic animals. I took my rabbit in, and the treatment couldn't have been better! Iñaki is a true professional: he knew instantly what was wrong, where to look, and how to proceed. He diagnosed the problem immediately and resolved everything very quickly. In addition to his exceptional professionalism, his approach was incredibly friendly, warm, and personalized. My rabbit and I left the appointment feeling so happy!

It's nothing like any other clinic I've been to before. I wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone who owns a rabbit.

They are excellent professionals. We found a pigeon in extreme conditions, they took him in urgently and immediately detected what they could do for him and what treatment to give him. After admission he has recovered completely. They saved his life.
The doctor is very good.
Grateful to Iñaki and his team for their treatment, help and professionalism
Excellent rabbit vet in Barcelona. My Netherland Dwarf rabbit had his teeth trimmed and filed at the clinic on Calle Viladomat. Very careful and professional treatment.

I took my lop rabbit to the emergency vet at Vetex in the Eixample district because of intestinal stasis. They saw us right away. You can tell they're specialists dedicated exclusively to exotic animals in Barcelona. My bunny recovered incredibly fast.
An excellent veterinarian, I have always brought my bunnies there.

A truly dedicated and caring professional with a genuine love for small animals. We had an emergency that couldn't wait until the next day (my pigeon seemed to have a broken wing), and even with a full schedule, they made time for us. We were very happy with the care they gave us and my pigeon. Although the visit was delayed and it was late, they didn't hesitate to give us their full time and thoroughly examine her to arrive at the correct diagnosis. I'm so glad I found them.

Excellent service from the staff. I had to wait a while because some emergencies arrived before my appointment, but I understand that those cases required priority attention. I was informed of the situation and it wasn't a problem.

My cockatiel, a lutino cockatiel, was very well cared for. They performed the necessary tests and gave me her diagnosis. Today, eight days later, she is fully recovered and has resumed her normal life.

TERROR EXPERIENCE AND SERIOUS NEGLIGENCE.
Yesterday at 6:00 pm I brought a very young and weakened pigeon. The initial attention from Érica was correct: she took my contact details and assured me verbatim that they would immediately stabilize it with serum and oxygen, and that I should return at 8:00 pm, and they would tell me anything by WhatsApp or call me.
My surprise and indignation was capital when at 8:00 pm I returned there and the "boss", Iñaki, took the animal EXACTLY AS I had left it two hours ago, inside the box that I had brought him and without having received any assistance. Absolutely nothing. Two critical hours lost on an animal in critical condition. The excuse she gave me was that "she didn't know me" and wanted to ask me if I would intervene. A ridiculous excuse, since they had my phone number and WhatsApp and could have consulted me instantly instead of leaving the animal unattended.

Why am I bringing you the pigeon? Why don't you help it? I have never encountered a situation like this at any other exotic veterinarian place, I was speechless.
An intravenous line for serum and oxygen is a basic stabilization procedure that is done in 3 minutes. What is the point of an exotic center if the team does not communicate and an agonizing patient is left locked in a box without the promised treatment?
Due to this total lack of attention, the animal has entered into unbearable agony right there and had to be euthanized.

Now, to anesthetize and make the puncture to kill it, with that we are going fast, Iñaki. Two hours! You should be ashamed.
On top of that, charging almost 50 euros for the puncture and the common incineration.
A lack of professional ethics, internal communication and absolute animal sensitivity.
I hope that people who bring rabbits here never find themselves in this situation.
And if you want to bring a pigeon, don't bring it here; any other exotics vet in Barcelona will surely treat you much better than this place, because if he doesn't feel like it, he won't operate on it. Totally regret having brought it here.
Iñaki is our parakeet vet! We're so happy with him; he takes excellent care of them and has explained how to look after them, since we're beginners. We're incredibly grateful.

Very humane and professional. Iñaki treated me; he was very kind and patient. He explains everything in detail, which gives you confidence and peace of mind knowing that they will treat your pet, and you will treat yours. Excellent veterinarian.
Great professionals, excellent and friendly service. They saved our snake's life and we are truly grateful for how they have treated us from day one.
They say they offer 24h emergency care but when we got there with our sick mouse it was completely closed. We couldn’t call them either. Scummy.
Very professional. Excellent service.

It was my first time visiting them, bringing a pigeon I found in the street. They advised me throughout and helped me understand the impossibility of the pigeon regaining its quality of life, and that fighting it wouldn't give the animal a dignified life. Sadly, it had to be euthanized 😞, but I'm glad it had a dignified end and wasn't left abandoned in the street like trash. The rescuer's fee was reasonable. They were professional and empathetic, two things that don't always go hand in hand. I recommend them and will definitely return if I need them again ❤️

I took a pigeon I found on the street that couldn't fly to visit, the treatment has been totally effective and the treatment by the veterinarian has been very good, he gives a lot of explanations so that you understand what is happening to the animal, you can tell that in this clinic they genuinely care about them🕊️ thank you🤍 …
Very kind and helpful, I took my hamster in for an emergency and they attended to us very quickly and with great dedication.
I take my African grey parrot there to visit; he's just started feather plucking. Good price and good professional.
I went yesterday with my guinea pig, the service was great, the assistant and the vet were super nice and friendly, 10/10

My Guinea pig had watery eyes that actually improved after being treated for parasites. The vet could not figure out what was wrong so we tried parasite treatment even though we couldn’t see any external parasites. His eyes eventually improved. The vet did not  suggest a body scan tho. This is just  to inform anyone with Guinea pigs who have undiagnosed watery eyes ….that 4 months later we noticed a massive lump on his belly that was eventually diagnosed by another vet as most likely cancer. The lump would of been there at the time of the visit with Vetex and if a body scan was offered we may have seen it in advance and would of been able to make the Guinea pigs last months more comfortable. (The watery eyes may of been the first symptoms that something ele was wrong internally and worth taking into consideration if you really want to take good care of your little loved ones )

Although we were not able to enjoy much of the veterinary services, we are very happy. Slow was very sick, and they did everything in their power to keep him alive, but unfortunately he was very old, and he was already very sick. We only have words of gratitude, Slow left without suffering, very well cared for and accompanied at all times. Thank you very much!

Excellent service. We bought a budgie and noticed it had mites. We called Vetex and were at the clinic the same day. The vet was very kind and professional, examined it, and gave us specific medication. He said he'd never seen a budgie so infested, poor thing. After follow-up appointments and medication, our budgie recovered completely within a few months. Thank you so much for your attention and for the patience and love you show to each pet.
Excellent specialists and very good service. Honest in their service and recommendations.
Excellent service, very friendly, highly recommended. Your pet will be well cared for here.
They treated us great! I highly recommend it!

It was our first time going for an emergency, and the experience was spectacular. We are so, so happy. We went yesterday with our guinea pig, Chispy, who hadn't eaten or drunk anything for several days and was quite ill. Thank you, thank you for the explanations, the care, and the experience with exotic animals. I don't know what else to say because there aren't enough stars; otherwise, I'd give you the whole sky! Chispy is doing great, eating well and happy.

We will definitely return for his checkups, even though it's a bit far for us, but it's worth it.

And what really surprised me, because I wasn't expecting it at all, was that after a week, they called us to see how Chispy was doing. I'm speechless. ❤️❤️ We will be back.
Excellent service and everything was very well explained; they are very pleasant.
My trusted veterinarian 🫂🤍 …
I don't recommend it. The wait time, the service, the quality of care, and the prices were all terrible. I regret taking my rabbit to this place.

Excellent service and true specialists in exotic animals.

I took my pet (a [animal name: rabbit, parrot, ferret…]) to Vetex and left with the peace of mind that I had left her in good hands. It's clear the team has extensive experience with exotic animals: they explain everything in detail, treat them with care, and always prioritize the animal's well-being above all else.

The facilities are clean and well-equipped, and the service was prompt and professional. They inspired confidence from the very first minute, something that isn't always easy when your companion isn't a dog or a cat.

Without a doubt, a leading center in Barcelona for those of us with "different" pets. Highly recommended.

They care more about money than animals. I spent a lot of money at Vetex. I went five times because my pet, Lily, had an infection. She was on antibiotics but wasn't getting better. They didn't disinfect where they put her or wear gloves. On the last day, I saw the vet who always treated me with ripped pants, squeezing rabbit droppings and handling pigeons people brought him from the street without gloves. I knew then that he wasn't going to touch Lily with those hands, which I never saw him wash or wear gloves with. To top it all off, he let two other people in ahead of me without asking. He must have thought I had all afternoon to be there. I picked Lily up and we left. He never called to ask how she was. Despite spending a lot of money, we were completely forgotten. 0% recommended.

I brought a pigeon home from the street about a month ago. It flew into the shop, and when I tried to get it out, it hit a window and got quite a nasty bruise. I saw blood, and I felt bad because it just stayed near the door, not moving. A girl who was passing by helped me find a vet, and we both came here. They treated us very well and gave us instructions on how to help the pigeon recover. I released the pigeon four days later, and it had made a perfect recovery! Anti-inflammatories, and it was flying again in no time.

Bad experience and dishonest! If you're not open, tell the truth and we'll change hospitals. I don't understand why you say you're open when the truth is no one answers the phone (well, actually, they answer and hang up, I don't understand!). Because of this incident, you caused a small animal to miss the best time to receive treatment!

Can't thank these guys enough! Assisting and helping me when I found a baby pigeon who was hit by a car. Truly empathatic, kind and professional. VETEX is animals first, regardless if there wild or not. If I ever get a pet, I would return in a heartbeat for there outstanding service. Thanks guys xxx

10 out of 10. Years ago, I used to take my rabbit there and remembered it as a reliable place. Years later, I took my tortoises there and loved it. Even though I live 30 km away, it has once again become my go-to place. Excellent service. I left very happy and at ease with my tortoise, a Pyrruhra molinae.

We went to take a baby dove that had fallen from its nest and hurt its right leg, but it was closed. There was no sign saying they were on vacation, and the phone only went to an answering machine saying they were open from 12 pm to 9 pm, which wasn't true. We went because our vet, who doesn't treat exotic animals, recommended it. We were very disappointed.

I'm so grateful to Iñaki for his care. I found an injured baby parakeet and couldn't leave her. I took her with me and looked for the first exotic vet I saw. Even though he was fully booked and didn't have an appointment, he saw us without hesitation. He went out of his way to help us. I know absolutely nothing about birds, and he explained how to care for Blue and all the steps to take. Her tibia was about to break. Thank goodness you helped us. You save lives, Iñaki, and you do it with such dedication. We need more empathetic and professional people like you.

It seems they're only in it for the money... an acquaintance of mine went there with her pigeon. They told her it had candida and parasites. Later that same day, she called to say it was vomiting its feed, and they told her to come back the next day for an x-ray to see what was wrong... but don't they know that candida causes vomiting? And they gave it all the medication at once... it's going to get poisoned.
Everyone was very attentive and friendly and they took great care of our gerbils Tom and Jerry.

We went about a year ago because our pet rat suddenly started urinating blood and was extremely weak. The reception staff were very helpful, but despite it being an emergency, the vet arrived about half an hour late, and from then on, the experience only went from bad to worse. We told him the rat had had a salt gnaw ball recommended by a pet store, but he said it was unrelated (even though our little rat clearly had kidney and dehydration problems, which neither my partner nor I noticed at the time due to anxiety and fear). He took a urine dipstick to check for infection, which was obviously unreadable because the urine was already bloody and very dark. He still charged us almost €20 for it, even verbally stating that the urine was dark and therefore unreadable.

After this, they offered us hospitalization and twenty other things, supposedly because our rat had a congenital problem that we hadn't noticed because we didn't have any other rats to compare it to, even though our animal had always been healthy and energetic. They told us it was very small and was sure to die, that the problem was genetic and had been there since birth. They offered us tests and a thousand other things for almost €400. They saw that we were a young couple, and I think they were trying to rip us off.

The visit was full of judgmental comments about us as the caretakers of our rat, which had always been healthy and full of energy. When we explained that the quietness and slowness were sudden, occurring that very afternoon, they judged us again and spoke to us rudely, declaring that "rats aren't like that and shouldn't be," and questioning how we hadn't noticed something was wrong "from the beginning" (we repeated at least three or four times that it was a change in behavior that very afternoon).

We rejected all the absurd treatments due to the lack of care shown to us and our little rat in such a delicate situation, when we thought she would die at any moment. We had zero confidence in a supposedly trained and professional person. Only after insisting and judging us for rejecting what she offered did she give us the option of buying the medication and administering it at home, as well as a heat lamp to help the animal maintain its temperature, since it was a bit low.

It didn't end there, because when we got home, the heat lamp on which OUR PET'S LIFE DEPENDED didn't work. No one thought to try it, even though it was VITAL. My partner and I spent days boiling water in a hot water bottle every two hours, even at night, because of this, since we didn't even want to change the light bulb again.

A year after that awful and painful visit, and after removing that salt ball and administering the medication, our rat is healthy, happy, and lively, although a bit old now at almost two years old, and with zero irreversible genetic problems, despite what they swore she had.

With us, at least, they were just money-grubbers and opportunists taking advantage of the situation. I've seen good reviews, so I assume not everyone had the same bad experience. Therefore, I advise that if you have rats, are young, and don't look your best (we're convinced they judged us partly by our appearance, despite adoring and caring for our pet), don't go to this place, especially not in an emergency.

I knew that if we admitted her, they would call us the next day with the worst possible news. I decided to take her home, and now she's doing wonderfully. It was NEVER because we couldn't afford it, but because what they offered was absurd, completely unreasonable given the situation, and they treated us terribly.

I'm leaving a picture of our rat, which, although they seem to have forgotten, is another member of our family.
Fantastic care for my little one, thank you very much
Very friendly and fast service

Excellent service; we've been taking our rabbit there for almost a year now. We're very grateful for the care, the explanations, and for teaching us how to take the best possible care of her. A wonderful team.
As always, great! We've known Iñaki for many years and he's always very pleasant and a good professional; it's a pleasure to make the trip to Barcelona.

My bird Coco was admitted a few days ago, and I couldn't be happier with the care and the results. In just a few days, he's improved tremendously. I want to sincerely thank the entire team, but especially the veterinarian, Iñaqui, who is a true professional and, on top of that, incredibly kind. I liked him from the very first moment: approachable, clear in his explanations, and with incredible sensitivity when treating animals (and people). Coco and I are so grateful.
He's become my new go-to vet! Highly recommended!

Excellent care and professionalism; the Vetex team was incredible from the very first moment. It's clear they have extensive experience with exotic animals and treat each patient with care and dedication. The doctor was very clear in his explanations and inspired a lot of confidence in me. Highly recommended!

Very friendly and professional service. However, they are so busy, and dedicate the necessary time to each visit, that the scheduled appointment is often delayed. Even so, the excellent care they provide for your pet (in our case, a rabbit) is well worth it.
A great veterinarian

I rescued a collared dove in very poor condition, with illnesses and injuries, and they helped her make a full recovery. I will always come back if the same thing happens in the future or if I have another exotic animal. They are very professional; you can tell they know what they are doing. Special thanks to Dr. Ignacio, who patiently ensured that, thanks to his treatments, my dove could be released with a good prognosis. If there were more stars, I would give them more. Thank you!
I've been taking my two pigeons and a turtle dove to Iñaki's vet for four years now, and what I admire most is his care and dedication.
Amazing!!! They are very affectionate with both the animals (obviously) and with me, since it was the first time I took my Chinchilla to have her teeth filed.

For Lizards:
They don't know enough. Look for another clinic. …
They treated me very well and gave me a complete check-up on a lovebird that I picked up from the street. They gave me a 50% discount for being a stray animal.
We've been going to this clinic for many years and I'm very happy. They treat our busy dog ​​with love and that's priceless.
Very attentive and friendly, especially during the difficult times we were going through with our pet.

If you have exotic animals, HIGHLY RECOMMENDED. 10/10. Iñaki and his colleagues helped me a lot with all the problems my bunny had until he couldn't take it anymore. The care is truly personal; they look after the animals very well and are …
We've been taking our rabbit Bambú there for two years now and we're very happy! The doctor is very attentive during checkups and explains everything very well. 👏👏 …
Veterinarian specializing in exotic animals, but primarily treating rabbits. Excellent service and attention, and a genuine interest in pet care.

I can only sing the praises of this clinic and its professionals. When everyone else washed their hands of my Blanquet, Ignacio fought tirelessly to save him. Over the past fourteen years, I've taken my various pets to several exotic animal …

He's my trusted vet for my two rabbits. I chose him after seeing the great reviews, and I couldn't have made a better choice. He's friendly and the price is excellent. Iñaki and his team are truly welcoming and make you feel comfortable and cared for. They genuinely care about your pet and keep a close eye on their progress.

I am eternally grateful for Vetex who have been taking care of my precious cockatiels for years now. The vet is gentle with animals, genuinely cares about them and is very knowledgeable. I am currently even using their services of “pet …
